name: v4 A-series: inharmonicity aux head (JEPA) and temporal ASP flow encoder, A1 / A2 / A3 (+ A0 when trained)
notes: Written before re-scoring. JEPA and flow are trained by separate optimisers on separate losses, and the flow is not conditioned on the JEPA (train_realistic_bass_v3.py), so each run informs two independent contrasts.
JEPA metrics: A1 and A3 have the same JEPA configuration (aux head, weight 100), so they are the JEPA replicate pair; A1 stopped at 11570 of 12000 steps, which makes the gauge slightly conservative.
Flow metrics: A2 and A3 have the same flow configuration (temporal_asp), so they are the flow replicate pair.
When A0 (conv flow, no aux head, seeded) exists, add it to b of aux_head and to b of temporal_asp, and add [A0, A2] to the jepa replicates and [A0, A1] to the flow replicates.
Primary metrics carry the Holm correction; secondary metrics are descriptive.
min_effect values are the smallest differences we would act on; they are not derived from these runs.
